# uptrace_org_member (Resource)

Makes the person at an email address a member of an organization with a role and a set of teams. A person who is not a member gets an invitation email, and the membership stays `pending` until they accept it; it is then `active`. An existing and a missing account get the same invitation. A change of the role or the teams of a pending membership sends no new email. `team_ids` is the exact set of teams of the person: do not also manage the same person with `uptrace_team_user`. Destroying the resource removes the member, or cancels the invitation. Requires an app version that serves `/internal/v1/orgs/{org_id}/members/by-email`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "main" {
  name = "Main"
}

resource "uptrace_team" "platform" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.main.id
  name   = "Platform"
}

# Invites alice@example.com. The membership is pending until she accepts the
# emailed invitation, and active after.
resource "uptrace_org_member" "alice" {
  org_id   = uptrace_org.main.id
  email    = "alice@example.com"
  role     = "admin"
  team_ids = [uptrace_team.platform.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The person's email address, lowercase and trimmed. Changing this forces recreation.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID. Changing this forces recreation.
- `role` (String) Organization role: owner, admin, member, viewer, billing_manager, or collaborator.

### Optional

- `team_ids` (Set of String) The exact set of team IDs of the person in the organization. Omitted or empty, the person is in no team. While the membership is pending, the teams the person joins on acceptance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<org_id>:<email>`.
- `org_user_id` (String) The org user ID of an active membership. Null while the membership is pending.
- `status` (String) `pending` while the invitation waits, `active` after the person accepts it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_org_member.example 123:alice@example.com
```
